function ke(e, t) {
	let n = Math.log10(e), r = 0;
	for (let e = t.length - 1; e >= 0; e--) r = r * n + t[e];
	return 10 ** r;
}
function R(e) {
	return Math.min(F, 4 + e * De);
}
for (let e = 0; e <= Oe; e++) {

function Ae(e) {
	return 6.683 + .04906 * e + 80.74 * Math.log(e);

function je(e) {
	return 9.705 + .0176 * e - 16e-7 * e ** 2;

var Me = I[Oe], Ne = Ae(N), Pe = ke(F, Te), Fe = je(N), Ie = Ee * (Me + Ne) / 2, z = -L[Oe] - Ie;
function Le(e) {
	return Math.min(4306, Math.floor((e - 4) / De));
}
function Re(e) {
	return (e - F) / Ee;
}
function ze(e, t, n) {
	return e + (t - e) * n ** 2 * (3 - 2 * n);
}
function Be(e) {
	if (Ce(e), e >= 293.15) return Ae(e);
	if (e >= F) return ze(Me, Ne, Re(e));
	let t = Le(e), n = (e - R(t)) / (R(t + 1) - R(t));
	return I[t] + n * (I[t + 1] - I[t]);
}
function Ve(e) {
	return Ce(e), e >= 293.15 ? je(e) : e >= F ? ze(Pe, Fe, Re(e)) : ke(e, Te);

function He(e) {
	return 6.683 * e + .02453 * e ** 2 + 80.74 * (e * Math.log(e) - e);
}
var Ue = He(N), We = He(P) - Ue;
function B(e) {
	if (e >= 293.15) return He(e) - Ue;
	if (e >= F) {
		let t = Re(e);
		return -Ie + Ee * (Me * t + (Ne - Me) * (t ** 3 - t ** 4 / 2));
	}
	let t = Le(e), n = e - R(t), r = R(t + 1) - R(t), i = (I[t + 1] - I[t]) / r;
	return z + L[t] + I[t] * n + i * n ** 2 / 2;
}
function Ge(e) {
	return Ce(e), B(e);
}
function Ke(e) {
	let t = 4, n = P;
	for (let r = 0; r < 48; r++) {
		let r = (t + n) / 2;
		B(r) < e ? t = r : n = r;
	}
	return (t + n) / 2;
}
function qe(e) {
	if (e < -Ie) {
		let t = 0, n = Oe;
		for (; n - t > 1;) {
			let r = Math.floor((t + n) / 2);
			z + L[r] <= e ? t = r : n = r;
		}
		let r = R(t + 1) - R(t), i = I[t], a = (I[t + 1] - i) / r, o = e - (z + L[t]), s = 2 * o / (i + Math.sqrt(i * i + 2 * a * o));
		return R(t) + s;
	}
	let t = e < 0 ? F : N, n = e < 0 ? N : P, r = e < 0 ? -Ie : 0, i = e < 0 ? 0 : We, a = t + (n - t) * (e - r) / (i - r);
	for (let r = 0; r < 6; r++) {
		let r = B(a);
		if (r === e) break;
		r < e ? t = a : n = a;
		let i = a - (r - e) / Be(a);
		if (i === a) break;
		a = i > t && i < n ? i : (t + n) / 2;
	}
	return a;
}
function Je(e) {
	if (V.length >= 8192) throw Error("Passive witness cap");
	if (V.push([e]), !Number.isFinite(e) || e < z || e > We) throw RangeError("304 specific enthalpy is outside the thermal fit domain");
	if (e === 0) return N;
	if (e === z) return 4;
	if (e === We) return P;
	let t = qe(e), n = 4, r = P, i = n, a = r;
	for (let e = 0; e < 48; e++) {
		let o = (n + r) / 2;
		o < t ? n = o : r = o, e === 39 && (i = n, a = r);
	}
	if (B(n) < e && B(r) >= e) return (n + r) / 2;
	if (B(i) < e && B(a) >= e) {
		n = i, r = a;
		for (let t = 40; t < 48; t++) {
			let t = (n + r) / 2;
			B(t) < e ? n = t : r = t;
		}
		return (n + r) / 2;
	}
	return Ke(e);
}

function Xe(e, t) {
	if (!Number.isFinite(e) || e <= 0) throw RangeError("304 mechanical temperature must be finite and positiveK");
	if (e > 1173.15) return 0;
	let n = 373.15, r = Ye[0][t];
	if (e <= n) return r;
	for (let i of Ye) {
		if (e <= i[0]) {
			let a = (e - n) / (i[0] - n);
			return r + a * (i[t] - r);
		}
		n = i[0], r = i[t];
	}
	return 0;
}
function Ze(e) {
	return Xe(e, 1);
}

	return Xe(e, 2);

//#region src/core/physics/damage-root.ts
function tt(e) {
	let t = .1 * e, n = .15 * e, r = .05 * e, i = .004;
	if (!(t > 2 * i && n > 2 * i)) throw RangeError("Invalid attachment section");
	let a = t * n - (t - 2 * i) * (n - 2 * i), o = (t * n ** 3 - (t - 2 * i) * (n - 2 * i) ** 3) / 12;
	return Object.freeze({
		area: a,
		inertia: o,
		modulus: 2 * o / n,
		length: r,
		heatArea: t * r,
		mass: Se * a * r
	});
}
function H(e, t) {
	return t === "plate" ? Math.sin(e) : Math.hypot(Math.sin(2 * e), 1.2 * Math.sin(e) ** 2);
}
function nt(e, t, n, r, i, a) {
	if (it.length >= 8192) throw Error("Passive witness cap");
	it.push([
		e,
		t,
		n,
		r,
		i.length,
		i.inertia,
		a
	]);
	let o = Math.abs(e), s = a === "plate" ? Math.PI / 2 : Math.PI / 4;
	if (!Number.isFinite(e) || o > s || t < 0 || n < 0 || !Number.isFinite(t) || !Number.isFinite(n)) throw RangeError("Attachment load outside the monotone force domain");
	let c = Ze(r);
	if (c === 0) return 0;
	if (o === 0 || t === 0 || n === 0) return e;
	let l = t * n * i.length / (c * i.inertia), u = o;
	for (let e = 0; e < 2; e++) {
		let e = H(u, a), t = Math.sin(u), n = Math.cos(u), r = a === "plate" ? n : e === 0 ? 2 : (2 * Math.sin(2 * u) * Math.cos(2 * u) + 2.88 * t ** 3 * n) / e;
		if (u -= (u + l * e - o) / (1 + l * r), !(u > 0 && u <= o)) break;
	}
	if (u > 0 && u <= o) {
		let t = 0, n = o;
		for (let e = 0; e < 40; e++) {
			let e = (t + n) / 2;
			e < u ? t = e : n = e;
		}
		if (t + l * H(t, a) < o && n + l * H(n, a) >= o) return Math.sign(e) * (t + n) / 2;
	}
	let d = 0, f = o;
	for (let e = 0; e < 40; e++) {
		let e = (d + f) / 2;
		e + l * H(e, a) < o ? d = e : f = e;
	}
	return Math.sign(e) * (d + f) / 2;
}
function rt(e, t, n) {
	let r = Qe(t) * n.modulus;
	return r === 0 ? Infinity : Math.abs(e) / r;
}

//#region src/core/physics/vehicle-components.ts
var st = 1525, ct = .004, lt = 144, ut = .0254, dt = 20 * Math.PI / 180;
function U(e, t, n, r, i) {
	if (!(t > 0 && i > 0) || !Number.isFinite(t + n + r + i)) throw RangeError("Component slice requires positive finite mass and inertia");
	return Object.freeze({
		role: e,
		mass: t,
		x: n,
		station: r,
		inertia: i
	});
}
function W(e, t, n, r, i = 0) {
	let a = n.reduce((e, t) => e + t.mass, 0), o = n.reduce((e, t) => e + t.mass * t.x, 0) / a, s = n.reduce((e, t) => e + t.mass * t.station, 0) / a, c = n.reduce((e, t) => e + t.inertia + t.mass * ((t.x - o) ** 2 + (t.station - s) ** 2), 0);
	return Object.freeze({
		id: e,
		kind: t,
		mass: a,
		x: o,
		station: s,
		inertia: c,
		loadLever: i,
		rootMass: n.reduce((e, t) => e + (t.role === "root" ? t.mass : 0), 0),
		tpsMass: n.reduce((e, t) => e + (t.role === "tps" ? t.mass : 0), 0),
		...r ? { hinge: Object.freeze({ ...r }) } : {},
		slices: Object.freeze(n)
	});
}
function ft(e, t, n, r, i, a, o, s, c) {
	if (!(n > 0 && r > 0)) throw RangeError("Appendage area and span must be positive");
	let l = n / r, u = Se * ct * n, d = i * (o + r / 2), f = i * (o + s.length / 2), p = s.heatArea / s.length, m = u * ((r * i) ** 2 + l ** 2) / 12, h = s.mass * ((s.length * i) ** 2 + p ** 2) / 12, g = [U("structure", u, d, a, m), U("root", s.mass, f, a, h)];
	if (c) {
		let e = lt * s.heatArea * ut;
		g.push(U("tps", e, f, a, e * ((s.length * i) ** 2 + p ** 2) / 12));
	}
	return W(e, t, g, {
		x: i * o,
		station: a
	}, r / 2);
}
function pt(e) {
	let { height: t, diameter: n, dryMass: r, dryCentreOfMass: i } = e;
	if (!(t > 0 && n > 0 && r > 0 && i > 0 && i < t) || !Number.isFinite(t + n + r + i)) throw RangeError("Invalid intact vehicle mass geometry");
	let a = n / 2, o = e.id === "ship", s = tt(n), c = [], l = t * (o ? .035 : .03), u = e.engines.length * st;
	if (c.push(W(`${o ? "ship" : "booster"}-engine-support`, "engine-support", [U("structure", u, 0, l / 2, u * (a ** 2 / 4 + l ** 2 / 12))])), o) {
		let i = r * .05;
		c.push(W("ship-nose", "nose", [U("structure", i, 0, t * .87, i * ((.4 * a) ** 2 + (.08 * t) ** 2) / 5)]));
		for (let t of [!0, !1]) for (let r of [-1, 1]) {
			let i = t ? e.frontFinStation : e.aftFinStation;
			c.push(ft(`ship-${t ? "front" : "aft"}-flap-${r < 0 ? "left" : "right"}`, "flap", (t ? e.frontFinArea : e.aftFinArea) / 2, n * (t ? .34 : .46), r, i, a, s, !0));
		}
	} else {
		let i = e.gridFins;
		if (!i || !Number.isInteger(i.count) || i.count < 3) throw RangeError("Booster component partition requires a grid inventory");
		let o = r * .02;
		c.push(W("booster-hot-stage", "hot-stage", [U("structure", o, 0, t * .975, o * (a ** 2 / 2 + (.05 * t) ** 2 / 12))]));
		for (let e = 0; e < i.count; e++) c.push(ft(`booster-grid-${e}`, "grid-fin", i.area / i.count, n * .46, Math.sin(dt + e * 2 * Math.PI / i.count), i.station, a, s, !1));
	}
	for (let e of c) if (!(e.station >= 0 && e.station <= t)) throw RangeError("Component centroid outside the hull");
	let d = r - c.reduce((e, t) => e + t.mass, 0);
	if (!(d > 0)) throw RangeError("No positive hull mass remains");
	let f = (r * i - c.reduce((e, t) => e + t.mass * t.station, 0)) / d, p = -c.reduce((e, t) => e + t.mass * t.x, 0) / d, m = r * (a ** 2 / 4 + t ** 2 / 12), h = (m - c.reduce((e, t) => e + t.inertia + t.mass * (t.x ** 2 + (t.station - i) ** 2), 0) - d * (p ** 2 + (f - i) ** 2)) / d - a ** 2 / 4, g = t * (o ? .055 : .05), _ = t * (o ? .72 : .93), v = t * (o ? .3 : .5), y = (f - g) * (_ - f);
	if (!(f > g && f < _ && h > 0 && h < y)) throw RangeError("Hull residual moments have no positive supported partition");
	let b = h / y, x = d * b * (_ - f) / (_ - g), S = d * b * (f - g) / (_ - g), C = d - x - S, w = [
		U("structure", x, p, g, x * a ** 2 / 4),
		U("structure", C, p, f, C * a ** 2 / 4),
		U("structure", S, p, _, S * a ** 2 / 4)
	], T = o ? "ship" : "booster", E = W(`${T}-hull-aft`, "hull", w.filter((e) => e.station < v)), D = W(`${T}-hull-forward`, "hull", w.filter((e) => e.station >= v));
	return c.push(E, D), Object.freeze({
		id: e.id,
		dryMass: r,
		dryCentreOfMassX: 0,
		dryCentreOfMass: i,
		dryMomentOfInertia: m,
		hullThermalMass: E.mass + D.mass,
		rootSection: s,
		components: Object.freeze(c)
	});
}

function X(e, t, n) {
	if (!Number.isFinite(e) || e < t || e > n) throw RangeError("LI900 temperature is outside its material property data domain");
}
function vt(e) {
	if (!Number.isFinite(e) || e < 0 || e > 101330) throw RangeError("LI900 pressure must be within0–101330Pa");
}
var Z = new Float64Array(q.length);
for (let e = 1; e < q.length; e++) {
	let t = q[e - 1], n = q[e];
	Z[e] = Z[e - 1] + (n[0] - t[0]) * (t[1] + n[1]) / 2;
}
function yt(e) {
	for (let t = 1; t < q.length; t++) if (e < q[t][0]) return t - 1;
	return q.length - 2;
}
function bt(e) {
	let t = yt(e), n = q[t], r = q[t + 1];
	if (e === r[0]) return Z[t + 1];
	let i = e - n[0], a = (r[1] - n[1]) / (r[0] - n[0]);
	return Z[t] + n[1] * i + a * i ** 2 / 2;
}
var xt = bt(_t), St = -xt, Ct = Z[q.length - 1] - xt;
function wt(e) {
	X(e, G, mt);
	let t = yt(e), n = q[t], r = q[t + 1];
	if (e === r[0]) return r[1];
	let i = (e - n[0]) / (r[0] - n[0]);
	return n[1] + i * (r[1] - n[1]);
}
function Tt(e) {
	return X(e, G, mt), bt(e) - xt;
}
function Et(e) {
	if (!Number.isFinite(e) || e < St || e > Ct) throw RangeError("LI900 specific enthalpy is outside the heat-capacity data domain");
	if (e === 0) return _t;
	if (e === St) return G;
	if (e === Ct) return mt;
	let t = e + xt, n = 0, r = q.length - 1;
	for (; r - n > 1;) {
		let e = Math.floor((n + r) / 2);
		Z[e] <= t ? n = e : r = e;
	}
	let i = q[n], a = q[n + 1], o = (a[1] - i[1]) / (a[0] - i[0]), s = t - Z[n], c = 2 * s / (i[1] + Math.sqrt(i[1] ** 2 + 2 * o * s));
	return Math.max(i[0], Math.min(a[0], i[0] + c));
}
function Dt(e, t) {
	let n = Y[0];
	if (t <= n[0]) return n[1][e];
	for (let n = 1; n < Y.length; n++) {
		let r = Y[n];
		if (t === r[0]) return r[1][e];
		if (t < r[0]) {
			let i = Y[n - 1], a = Math.log(t / i[0]) / Math.log(r[0] / i[0]);
			return i[1][e] + a * (r[1][e] - i[1][e]);
		}
	}
	return Y[Y.length - 1][1][e];
}
function Ot(e, t) {
	for (let n = 1; n < J.length; n++) {
		let r = J[n];
		if (e === r) return Dt(n, t);
		if (e < r) {
			let i = J[n - 1], a = Dt(n - 1, t), o = Dt(n, t);
			return a + (e - i) / (r - i) * (o - a);
		}
	}
	return Dt(J.length - 1, t);
}
function kt(e, t) {
	return X(e, ht, K), vt(t), Ot(e, t);
}
function At(e, t, n) {
	if (X(e, ht, K), X(t, ht, K), vt(n), e === t) return Ot(e, n);
	let r = Math.min(e, t), i = Math.max(e, t), a = 0;
	for (let e = 1; e < J.length; e++) {
		let t = Math.max(r, J[e - 1]), o = Math.min(i, J[e]);
		o > t && (a += (o - t) * (Ot(t, n) + Ot(o, n)) / 2);
	}
	return a / (i - r);
}

function Q(e, t) {
	if (!Number.isFinite(e) || !Number.isFinite(t)) throw RangeError("Thermal state requires finite temperature and energy");
	return {
		valid: !0,
		temperature: e,
		energy: t
	};

function Mt(t, n) {
	let r = t.components.length;
	if (r < 1 || r > 12) throw RangeError("Damage inventory must contain1–12 components");
	if (!(t.hullThermalMass > 0) || !Number.isFinite(t.hullThermalMass)) throw RangeError("Damage state requires positive finite hull thermal mass");

	if (a) {
		if (n < 116.667 || n > 1922.04) throw RangeError("TPS ambient temperature is outside its thermal data domains");
		o = Tt(n);
	}
	let s = t.components.map((t, r) => {
		if (!(t.rootMass >= 0 && t.tpsMass >= 0) || !Number.isFinite(t.rootMass + t.tpsMass)) throw RangeError("Invalid component thermal mass");
		let a = t.rootMass > 0 ? Q(n, t.rootMass * i) : Q(0, 0), s = () => t.tpsMass > 0 ? Q(n, t.tpsMass / 2 * o) : Q(0, 0);
		return {
			componentIndex: r,
			attached: !0,
			permanentFailure: 0,
			root: a,
			tps: [s(), s()],
			loadedAngle: e(0)
		};
	}), c = s.map((t) => ({
		componentIndex: t.componentIndex,
		active: !1,
		x: 0,
		altitude: 0,
		pitch: e(0),
		speedX: 0,
		speedY: 0,
		angularVelocity: 0
	}));
	return {
		components: s,
		hull: Q(n, t.hullThermalMass * i),
		debris: c,
		terminal: {
			active: !1,
			reason: 0,
			time: 0,

			speedX: 0,
			speedY: 0,

			releasedMomentumY: 0,
			releasedAngularMomentum: 0,
			releasedKineticEnergy: 0
		},
		revision: 0,
		eventCount: 0
	};
}

function Nt(e, t) {
	let n = [];
	for (let r = 0; r < e.components.length; r++) {
		let i = e.components[r];
		if (i.kind === "grid-fin") {
			let e = t.gridFins;
			if (!e) throw RangeError("Grid component requires grid geometry");
			n.push(Object.freeze({
				index: r,
				group: "grid",
				area: e.area / e.count,
				lever: i.loadLever
			}));
		} else if (i.kind === "flap") {
			let e = i.id.includes("-front-");
			n.push(Object.freeze({
				index: r,
				group: e ? "front" : "aft",
				area: (e ? t.frontFinArea : t.aftFinArea) / 2,
				lever: i.loadLever
			}));
		}
	}
	return Object.freeze({
		componentCount: e.components.length,
		root: e.rootSection,
		columns: Object.freeze(n)
	});
}
function Pt(e) {

		aftFraction: 0,
		gridLiftArea: 0,

		proofMask: 0,
		domainMask: 0
	};
}
function Ft(e, t, n, r, i) {

function It(e, t, n, r, i, a, o) {

	let s = !1, c = 0, l = 0, u = 0, d = 0, f = 0, p = 0, m = 0, h = "grid";
	for (let g of t.columns) {
		let _ = e.components[g.index];
		if (!_.attached || _.permanentFailure !== jt.None) continue;
		if (!_.root.valid || Qe(_.root.temperature) === 0) {
			o.domainMask |= 1 << g.index;
			continue;
		}

			o.proofMask |= 1 << g.index;
			continue;
		}
		if (v) o.gridLiftArea += g.area * Math.sin(2 * O), o.gridDragArea += g.area * 1.2 * Math.sin(O) ** 2;
		else {
			let e = Math.sin(O);

		}
	}

var Lt = 4096, Rt = .8, zt = 8, Bt = .0254, Vt = Bt / 2, Ht = Bt / 4, Ut = Math.max(G, ht), $ = Math.min(mt, K), Wt = Rt * C, Gt = Ge(4), Kt = Ge(P), qt = Tt(Ut), Jt = Tt($);
function Yt(e) {
	let t = e.components.length, n = e.rootSection;
	if (t < 1 || t > 12 || !(e.hullThermalMass > 0 && n.area > 0 && n.length > 0 && n.heatArea > 0) || !Number.isFinite(e.hullThermalMass + n.area + n.length + n.heatArea)) throw RangeError("Invalid thermal catalogue geometry/inventory");

	for (let s = 0; s < t; s++) {
		let t = e.components[s];
		if (!(t.rootMass >= 0 && t.tpsMass >= 0) || !Number.isFinite(t.rootMass + t.tpsMass)) throw RangeError("Invalid component thermal masses");
		if (t.rootMass === 0) {
			if (t.tpsMass > 0) throw RangeError("TPS column requires a finite root");
			continue;
		}
		let g = t.tpsMass / 2, _ = t.rootMass * r;
		if (g > 0) {
			let e = o * n.heatArea / Vt, t = 1 / (Ht / (o * n.heatArea) + l / i), r = g * a;
			m = Math.min(m, r / (e + f), r / (e + t), _ / (t + u));
		} else m = Math.min(m, _ / (u + d));
		h += u, p.push(Object.freeze({
			componentIndex: s,
			rootMass: t.rootMass,
			tpsCellMass: g,
			heatArea: n.heatArea,
			steelPathRatio: c,
			steelResistanceRatio: l,
			rootMinEnergy: t.rootMass * Gt,
			rootMaxEnergy: t.rootMass * Kt,
			tpsMinEnergy: g * qt,
			tpsMaxEnergy: g * Jt
		}));
	}
	return h > 0 && (m = Math.min(m, e.hullThermalMass * r / h)), Object.freeze({
		componentCount: t,
		columns: Object.freeze(p),
		hullMass: e.hullThermalMass,
		hullMinEnergy: e.hullThermalMass * Gt,
		hullMaxEnergy: e.hullThermalMass * Kt,
		safeStep: m
	});
}

function Qt(e, t, n, r, i, a) {
